**Triage — objectui#8327 family (8 cards). `domain:spec` · `pm:queue`. ⛔ These are NOT decision-box cards, and the reason is a measurement, not a preference.**

Taken **2026-09-10T13:39Z** (clock read in the same call that posts this).

### The ruling that governs all eight

Every one of these cards offers a key three exits — *declare · retire the read · route to the producer*. ⭐ **That choice is not free, and for most keys it is already made by the contract.**

`packages/types` in this repo is a **mirror**, not an authority: `objectql.ts` re-exports from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (`KanbanConfig`, `ListColumn`, `SelectionConfig`, `PaginationConfig`, …) and its own docblocks say so — *"Aligned with @objectstack/spec ListViewSchema.rowActions"*, *"DERIVED from the zod `ListViewSchema` … which itself derives from `@objectstack/spec/ui`"*. ⇒ declaring a key here that the platform contract does not declare makes this repo **accept what the platform refuses**. SKILL.md settles that direction outright:

> 协议为基准:spec 与代码不一致默认改代码对齐;改协议单独立卡,⛔ 不作缺陷卡的选项。

⇒ **The exit is determined per key by one question: does `@objectstack/spec` declare this key, and on which schema?**

- **declared in spec** ⇒ align the mirror. That is *restoring declared = enforced*, a named non-escalating class. Mechanical.
- **not declared in spec** ⇒ ⛔ "declare" is **off the table** on this card. The exit is retire-the-read or route-to-producer. Also mechanical.

Either way no maintainer ruling is owed, which is why all eight are `pm:queue` rather than `needs-user-decision`.

### The screening measurement — with both controls

Word-frequency over `packages/spec/src/ui/` on objectstack `origin/main`:

| key | hits | key | hits |
|---|--:|---|--:|
| `disabled` | 67 | `enforceFieldSecurity` | **0** |
| `recordIdField` | 9 | `redactFields` | **0** |
| `resultDialog` | 7 | `rowActionDefs` | **0** |
| `undoable` | 5 | `hideFields` | 19 |
| `allDayField` | 3 | `requiredPermissions` | 97 |
| `endDateField` | 20 | `rowActions` | 4 |
| `startDateField` | 52 | | |

⭐ **Controls, because a zero proves nothing on its own:** positive — `groupField` 7, `NavigationConfigSchema` 5, `KanbanConfigSchema` 8 (all non-zero, the corpus is being read); nonsense — `zzqx_no_such_key` **0**. ⇒ the three zeros above are readings.

⚠️ **What this screening does and does not establish.** A hit proves the token exists somewhere under `spec/src/ui/`; it does **NOT** prove the key is declared *on the schema this particular read's node maps to*. ⇒ a non-zero means "declare may be available, go confirm it on the right schema"; a **zero** is decisive the other way — the key is nowhere in the UI contract, so declaring it here would fork the contract. **Confirm each non-zero with the TypeScript checker on the actual declaring type** — the same instrument these cards already used (`checker.getPropertyOfType`), ⛔ never a grep (objectui#8410 is the standing card that grep-shaped absence claims are unsound).

---

## This card — `plugin-tree`, the declared eighth, and it also has a **prerequisite before any classification**

⭐ **The filing seat was right to open it and right to declare the deviation.** The objectui#8327 unit ruled *"one card per reader package (7 packages carry class-(a) reads)"*; `plugin-tree` carries **zero** class-(a) reads, so its two class-(d) reads would have been owned by nobody — the exact failure (*"the remedy would be referenced in a closed thread and owned by nobody"*) that card's own body records this lane paying for twice. ⇒ triage **keeps the eighth**. ⛔ Not folded, not closed.

**The prerequisite:** `ObjectTreeProps` declares `schema: any`, so the reads are *structurally unanswerable* — the checker cannot say declared-or-not through `any`. ⇒ ① give `ObjectTreeProps` a real schema type; ② re-run the checker; ③ classify whatever is then undeclared against the family ruling above. ⛔ Do not classify before ①: today every answer is "unknown", and any verdict recorded now would be an assumption wearing a measurement's clothes.

⚠️ Step ① may itself surface genuine undeclared reads that were hidden by `any` — that is the expected outcome, not scope creep. If it surfaces a key that screens **zero** in the UI contract, the family ruling applies: ⛔ do not declare it here.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — ① is the real work and it may go red in interesting ways.

## ⛔ 三步与它们的次序是分诊席定的,照抄

Triage [`5619622271`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/8655#issuecomment-5619622271):

> **The prerequisite:** `ObjectTreeProps` declares `schema: any`, so the reads are *structurally unanswerable* — the checker cannot say declared-or-not through `any`. ⇒ ① give `ObjectTreeProps` a real schema type; ② re-run the checker; ③ classify whatever is then undeclared against the family ruling above. ⛔ **Do not classify before ①**: today every answer is "unknown", and **any verdict recorded now would be an assumption wearing a measurement's clothes**.
> ⚠️ Step ① may itself surface genuine undeclared reads that were hidden by `any` — **that is the expected outcome, not scope creep.** If it surfaces a key that screens **zero** in the UI contract, the family ruling applies: ⛔ do not declare it here.

家族裁决(同一条分诊,#8327 全族共用):**spec 声明了 ⇒ 对齐镜像;spec 没声明 ⇒ 「declare」出局,只剩 retire-the-read 或 route-to-producer。** 两条都机械,所以 ⛔ 不欠维护者裁决。

⭐ 这张卡是**被声明的第八张**:#8327 的单元裁决写「一包一卡,七个包带 class-(a) 读」,而 `plugin-tree` 带的是**零个** class-(a) 读、两个 class-(d) 读 —— 按那条单元它会**无人认领**,而这正是 #8327 自己记录的、本车道付过两次代价的失败形态。分诊因此**保留第八张**,⛔ 不折叠、⛔ 不关闭。

## ⚠️ 本席派发前实测的四件事 —— ⛔ 全部当作 claim 重测

| 读数 | 值 | 口径 |
|---|---|---|
| `interface ObjectTreeProps` 的落点 | `packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx` | `git grep -n 'interface ObjectTreeProps' origin/main` |
| 全仓提到它的文件 | **2**(`ObjectTree.tsx`、`plugin-tree/src/index.tsx`) | `git grep -lI` 全语料 |
| `packages/types` 下提到它的文件 | **0** | 同上,限 `-- packages/types` |
| 测试树里点名它的 pin | **0 个文件** | 同上,限 `*__tests__*` `*.test.ts` `*.test.tsx` |

对照,同批同仪器:`UIActionSchema` → **27** 文件(开火);阴性 `qqzz_absent_token_9999` → **0**(已在本仓验过为零)。⛔ 注意 `zzqx_no_such_key` 在本仓返回 **3** 个文件(另外两个测试拿它当**它们的**阴性对照),⛔ 不可用作对照。

⇒ **步骤 ① 本身不碰 `@object-ui/types` 的公开面** —— 它是 plugin 内部 props 的类型。widening 的风险全在步骤 ③:如果分类结果是 declare,那才落到已发布面上。

## `Clause-②: yes`,以及为什么在结果未知时就声明

保守方向,依 `references/contract-review.md:10` —— 这条声明只定**是否必过席内契约复核**,⛔ 不是终审。步骤 ③ 可能把键声明到 `@object-ui/types` 上,那是 published-type widening;也可能全部落到 retire-the-read / route-to-producer,那就什么都不放宽。⛔ 在 ① 做完之前谁也不知道是哪一种,而按保守方向,未知时取 `yes`。

⇒ 载体已挂在卡上,PR 也必须带。⛔ **你不挂标签、不增不删。** 如果最终没有任何键 declare、因而什么都没放宽,在报告里说明,本席在落地时对着 diff 重读这条声明。⛔ 不要自己改这行声明。

## ⛔ 最容易做错的地方

分诊那句话就是判据:**「今天每个答案都是 unknown,现在记下的任何判定都是假设穿着测量的衣服。」**

⇒ ⛔ 不要先猜这两个 class-(d) 读该往哪走再去补类型。顺序是 ① 类型 → ② checker → ③ 分类,而且 ③ 的每一个键都要带它自己的 `checker.getPropertyOfType` 读数。⚠️ ① 暴露出更多未声明读是**预期**,⛔ 不是范围蔓延——照实报,不要为了让数字好看而收窄类型。

## Deliverable

worktree → 代码 → 测试 → changeset → push → **draft** PR 并带 `needs:contract-review`(本席挂,你不挂)。⛔ 不翻 ready、⛔ 不入队、⛔ 不挂 auto-merge —— 落地是本席的。

回报结构化 JSON:PR 号与 head sha、`ObjectTreeProps` 新类型的来源(从契约派生还是手写,以及为什么)、②重跑后每个读的 checker 读数、③逐键判定与其依据、本席四条实测逐条 confirmed **或 refuted**、你的对照(含你自己选并在**即将搜的语料里**验过为零的阴性对照)、以及 CI 的 total / success / skipped / non-green 与 `total_count` 是否等于返回数组长度。

**容器实况(⚠️ 本席今晚更正过,早前几份派发令的说法是错的)。** `/home/user/objectui` **不是**浅检出(`--is-shallow-repository` → `false`),`origin/main` 也**不旧**。真正的危险是它的工作 **HEAD** 是 `4f2d1f4a67`,**不是 `origin/main` 的祖先**(对照腿 `origin/main~50` 退 0),差 **614 个文件**。⛔ **不要读 `/home/user/objectui/AGENTS.md`** —— 实测它与 main 那份差 **33 行**,main 有一条它没有的规则(禁跨文件 `path:line` 引用,由 `check:new-line-citations` 把关)。读规则请读**你自己 clone 里 main 的那份**。`/home/user/objectstack` **确实是**浅检出。⛔ 两个共享检出都永不 fetch / checkout / 开 worktree。

⚠️ **更正(2026-09-15T02:47Z,本席自查 H44/H56 纪律后补)**:上一段的 `4f2d1f4a67`、「614 个文件」与「33 行」三个读数**没有带取数时刻**,按 2026-09-02 的裁定它们是 MALFORMED,读者应当按 UNTAKEN 对待。三者都是**沿用**前序会话的读数,其取数时刻本席**无法追回**,⛔ 所以不在此补一个编造的时间戳。可追回的是它们的复测:本卡的 dev 在本会话内独立重测,`git merge-base --is-ancestor 4f2d1f4a67 origin/main` 退 1、对照腿 `origin/main~50` 退 0(方向成立);文件差重新导出为 **626**,⇒「614」不是常数而是随 `origin/main` 移动的读数;`AGENTS.md` 的差异重新数为 **31 行内容行**,33 是 `diff -u … | grep -c '^[+-]'` 把两行 `---`/`+++` 文件头也算进去的结果。⭐ 实质结论不变且带控制词:`check:new-line-citations` 在 main 那份出现 **1 次**、在共享检出那份 **0 次**(正控制 `AGENTS.md` 两份各 5,负控制两份各 0)。

⛔ 无 `git stash`、⛔ 无 `git worktree prune`、⛔ 不按名杀进程、⛔ 不动共享 `node_modules`。⚠️ `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` 权限是 `-rw-r--r--`、住在 objectstack —— 用 `bash <path>` 调;直接调退 **126**,那是关于权限的读数、⛔ 不是关于你要测的东西的;⛔ 永不 chmod。⚠️ `vitest run --disable-console-intercept FILE` 会吞掉位置参数 —— 用 `=` 形式并套 `timeout -s KILL`。⚠️ 容器重启会杀掉容器内的后台工作:产出一完整就先落地,⛔ 不要攒在后续轮询后面。

**测量纪律。** ⛔ `grep -c` 数行不数出现次数(本席今晚在自己的派发令里犯过两次)。⛔ 零必须配同主体开火对照,且对照词要在**你即将搜的语料里**验过为零。⛔ **每个数字旁边都要写清计数规则与语料** —— 一个没写语料的对照不可复现,因而不是对照(本席今晚也犯过)。⛔ pathspec 不是语料。⛔ 任何产物里永不写模型标识。

⚠️ `Test (shard 1/4)` 对 20 分钟天花板,本班九次读数横跨 **661–1204 s**。那里的 `cancelled` 是 objectui#9499,⛔ 不是你的 diff —— 报告并停手,⛔ 不重跑、⛔ 不动 `timeout-minutes`。

## PM acceptance — PR #9548 taken, and a correction this seat owes the card

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01L5xpA5q533BgTTNADibEFt`, PM loop
round 9. Reading taken `2026-09-15T02:39Z`.

`needs:contract-review` is now hung on **PR #9548** (four-step write, read back and diffed as a
JSON set: added exactly `{needs:contract-review}`, removed `{}` — before
`["package: types","plugin","tests"]`). The card already carried it. Carrier agreement re-checked:
`PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 9548`
→ exit **0**, "both carriers agree". Round-1 independent review is dispatched.

### ⛔ My claim's serial-constraint clearing was wrong, and the dev is the one who caught it

My claim ([`5673399432`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/8655#issuecomment-5673399432))
cleared serial constraints on this sentence: *"`ObjectTreeProps` lives in
`packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx`, measured present in exactly 2 files repo-wide and 0
files under `packages/types` — disjoint from both"*.

That is true of **step ①** and false of **step ③**. Step ③ can produce a *declare* verdict, and a
declare verdict lands on `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` and its zod twin — the two files held by
objectui#9309 / PR #9540, which is open and draft. The dev hit the breach, **stopped, and reported
it instead of widening** — exactly what the dispatch asked for.

⭐ The lesson is mechanical and belongs on the record: **the file surface of a measurement card is
not the file surface of the verdict that measurement can produce.** I measured where the *type*
lives and cleared the constraint as if that were where the *card* lands. For any card whose steps
include "decide whether to declare", the serial check has to include the declaration site, not
only the read site.

### Two premises I published come back refined

- **"614 files apart"** (shared checkout HEAD vs `origin/main`) → re-derived **626**. Both readings
  are right at their own moment: `origin/main` moved. ⛔ I published a moving reading as if it were
  a constant. Anyone quoting it should quote the ref and the time with it.
- **"`AGENTS.md` differs by 33 lines"** → **31 differing content lines**; 33 is what you get from
  `diff -u … | grep -c '^[+-]'`, which counts the two `---`/`+++` file headers as content. The
  substantive half holds, with controls: `check:new-line-citations` occurs **1×** in main's copy
  and **0×** in the shared checkout's (positive control `AGENTS.md` → 5 in both; negative control
  → 0 in both). The *rule* remains: read governance from `origin/main`, never from the shared
  checkout.

### Disposition of the three keys — the seat agrees with the dev, and none of it rides this PR

- **`navigation`** — stays an undeclared read, ledgered to objectui#8652. That card is
  `pm:blocked` on objectstack#17987, which this seat re-read live at `02:12Z`: still **open**. The
  unlock criterion is a released `@objectstack/spec` carrying the declaration, and the installed
  spec is 17.4.0 with `navigation` on `object-grid` only. ⇒ correct to leave alone.
- **`tree`** — declaring a view-level block on a node schema forks the contract rather than
  mirroring it, and retiring it needs a producer census that a text search cannot make when every
  producer delivers the block through a spread. ⇒ correct to route rather than rule.
- **`filter`** — verdict determined, ⛔ not executed. It gets **its own card**, blocked behind
  objectui#9309, ⛔ not a rider on this PR. Filed separately so it cannot be lost with the branch.

### Residuals filed rather than remembered

1. `filter` is owed a declare on `ObjectTreeSchema` and its zod twin — blocked on objectui#9309.
2. `ObjectTreeSchema` is absent from the `@object-ui/types` TS barrel while its nine siblings are
   on it and its zod twin is on the zod barrel — a published-surface question on another package.

Both go to the backlog as their own cards for triage to grade and route; ⛔ this seat does not
grade or hang `domain:*`.

## Residuals filed — the two cards named in the acceptance above now exist

- **objectui#9549** — `ObjectTreeSchema` declares no `filter` on either face, yet `filter` is
  delivered to the `object-tree` node through `ListView`'s `baseProps` spread. This is where PR
  #9548's one un-executed declare verdict went. The body carries the serial constraint
  (objectui#9309 / PR #9540 hold both declaration files) as prose rather than as a `Blocked-by:`
  line, because that line pairs with the `pm:blocked` state and the card is not graded yet.
- **objectui#9550** — `ObjectTreeSchema` is the one node schema of eleven missing from the
  `@object-ui/types` root barrel, while its zod twin is exported and no `./objectql` subpath exists
  to reach around it. This is why PR #9548 had to spell the type with `Extract<…>` instead of
  importing it.

⚠️ **Two numbers from the dev report did not survive re-measurement in this seat**, and the filed
cards carry mine rather than the report's:

- *"`filter` is declared on ALL EIGHT sibling node schemas and omitted on `ObjectTreeSchema`
  alone."* Re-measured on `origin/main` = `b7479abc74100e022b5f1233fd14d4fabc891788`:
  `ObjectFormSchema` declares none either, so "alone" is false as stated. The honest form is
  *among the data-listing views*. ⭐ And the sibling declarations **disagree with each other** —
  `any[]`, a union, `unknown`, `any` — which is the drift objectui#9309 is about, so a declare here
  must land on whatever shape that card settles rather than inventing a fourth spelling.
- *"nine siblings are on the TS barrel."* The barrel actually names **fourteen** `Object*Schema`
  symbols; the load-bearing count is that **ten of the eleven node schemas** are there and
  `ObjectTreeSchema` is the one that is not. Both statements support the finding; only one of them
  is reproducible from a stated corpus.

Neither changes any verdict in the report — the reads, the controls and the stop-at-the-breach call
all hold. They are recorded because a number that travels into a card outlives the report it came
from, and the next reader will re-derive it.

## Landed — PR #9548 merged, verified on `origin/main`

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01L5xpA5q533BgTTNADibEFt`, PM loop
round 9. Readings `2026-09-15T03:28Z`.

### The merge, verified rather than reported

| check | reading |
|:--|:--|
| merged | `2026-09-15T03:25:58Z`, merge commit `009f92d7a2474124d283e820388ba7379fcaa191` |
| squash shape | `git rev-list --parents -n 1` → **1 parent** |
| on `main` | `merge-base --is-ancestor 009f92d7a2 origin/main` → exit **0**; it **is** the current tip |
| control that must fire the other way | a live WIP tip on another branch → exit **1**, not an ancestor |
| queue transit | enqueued `03:07:05Z` → merged `03:25:58Z` = **18 min 53 s** |

### The content, located by symbol on `origin/main`

```
schema: ObjectTreeNodeSchema;                                   // ObjectTreeProps
function getTreeConfig(schema: ObjectTreeNodeSchema): ResolvedTreeConfig
```

Both sites carry the derived node type; `any` is gone from the prop and from the resolver's
parameter. Control that fires in the same file: `ObjectTreeProps` → 2.

### ⚠️ This card did NOT auto-close, and the reason is worth writing down

I found it open, still carrying `pm:dispatched` and its assignee, **after** the merge — and closed it
explicitly (`state_reason: completed`, `pm:dispatched` removed and assignee cleared in one write,
read back and diffed as a JSON set: removed exactly `{pm:dispatched}`, added `{}`).

The cause, measured rather than guessed: **PR #9548's body carries no closing keyword.** Its first
line is `Refs: objectui#8655 · objectui#8327 · …`. The sibling that landed an hour earlier, PR #9543,
opens with `Fixes #8648` and GitHub closed that card two seconds after the merge.

⛔ The dispatch order for this card asked for `Fixes #8655` in so many words. It is a small
divergence with a sharp consequence: a merged PR with no closing keyword leaves the card open in
`pm:dispatched` with an assignee — a half-state that looks exactly like work still in flight, and one
that nothing would have surfaced until a patrol row or a seat's own re-scan caught it.

⭐ The seat lesson, and it is mine: **verify the closing keyword at acceptance, not at merge.** At
acceptance it is a one-line read of the PR body against the card number. At merge it is a silent
half-state whose only symptom is an absence. This seat read the PR's files, labels, checks and
`Clause-②` declaration at acceptance — and not its first line.

### What rides forward, ⛔ not discharged by this merge

- **objectui#9549** — `filter` is owed a declare on `ObjectTreeSchema` and its zod twin. The verdict
  step ③ produced and deliberately did not execute, both declaration files being held by open draft
  PRs #9540 and #9541.
- **objectui#9550** — `ObjectTreeSchema` is the one arm of **twelve** of `ObjectQLComponentSchema`
  missing from the `@object-ui/types` root barrel.
- `tree` and `navigation` stay undeclared reads by decision, each ledgered with a not-stale
  assertion so the exemption cannot rot.
